edits.before: He out-ranges the general — farm through the poke, land ONE root per wave cycle, and drag the lane toward the brawl you win.
edits.after: Vlad is the one drain mage you out-bully — punish levels 1 through 6 hard, because at two items the healing math flips on you.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by dodging your all-in with Sanguine Pool, farming safely, and out-healing you once items land.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Nevermove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 16s max, 2s untargetable — bait it, wait the 2 seconds, then all-in the long downtime. - His Q Transfusion is 9s early — trade in the gap right after he spends it on a minion.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Vision of Empire's huge cast range means the slow still tags him as Pool ends — throw it on his exit path and the Q follow-up connects.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: At half HP his Transfusion chip and Tides of Blood finish the job for free — reset or force the fight before you get there.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Vlad has only a 9-second Transfusion at level 1 and no stacks — walk up and Q-poke him off every last-hit for free.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: You still hold the HP lead — his item sustain is not online, so keep rooting the step-up and all-in when Pool is down.
